question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Santra took a deep breath before __________ onto the stage to deliver her speech.
solution:
The correct answer is '**stepping**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**stepping**" means to lift and set down one's foot or one foot after the other. (चरण करना)
 
• The phrase "stepping onto the stage" is a common expression used when someone is about to start a performance or speech.
 
• The other options: "**stuck**," "**hit**," and "**made**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Santra took a deep breath before stepping__ onto the stage to deliver her speech.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stuck (फंसना)**: means to be caught or fixed in a particular position.
 
• **Hit (मारना)**: means to come into contact with forcefully.
 
• **Made (बनाया)**: means created or formed.
